includedFixes.summary: wait for restart gates before reporting readiness
includedFixes.before: the first request after a product restart could return 503 maintenance while start() already reported ready (reproduced 10/10)
includedFixes.after: 10/10 restarts return ready and the school activity, v1 basis and work bytes survive stop/start

includedFixes.summary: report starting when a status probe predates readiness
includedFixes.before: start() returned failed with 'PostgreSQL startup is in progress' when a probe began before initialization
includedFixes.after: the call reports starting and the CLI retries; 10/10 restart stress tests return ready

includedFixes.summary: keep the requested activity across context recovery
includedFixes.before: a transient first-context failure dropped a URL-requested pinned activity back to the list
includedFixes.after: the requested activity survives recovery; the v2 registration flow keeps the existing v1 activity

includedFixes.summary: read the latest open activity during context recovery
includedFixes.before: a poll finishing after the activity opened could still clear it and return to the catalogue
includedFixes.after: recovery reads the current view and reopens the activity (a brief list render during the refetch remains possible)

includedFixes.after: course editor input and the shared 15 Chrome regressions pass
